items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation ALB, the world's largest lithium producer, has suffered as lithium prices have tanked ~80% from their late 2022 highs. Slowing electric vehicle sales, increased lithium supply, and other headwinds are weighing on Albemarle stock. Downward earnings revisions

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year, still well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, lowering lithium company targets following recent spot price weakness while viewing the group as oversold.
